verdict.rationale: CrewAI's docs describe agents, tasks, crews, and flows for building custom automations, but nothing in the evidence pack describes a built-in bulk/batch operation capability (e.g., iterating a task or crew across many items/records in one invocation). Missing for 10: any documentation of a batch-processing or bulk-item API, examples of applying a task across a dataset, or performance/scale claims for many-item runs.
